docs: The admin; pays for the new accounts.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The test-USDC mint pinned in the config.

instructions.name: admin_settle_override
docs: Admin settlement with a manual price after the delay (FR-09).

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin.

instructions.name: buy_no
docs: Mint pair + sell YES (FR-06). Stub until M1-06.

accounts.name: user
docs: The user buying NO; pays rent for `open_orders` on first use.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Cancels the owner's resting order (FR-05). Stub until M1-05.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The order owner.

accounts.name: open_orders
docs: Receives the refund. Its PDA seeds name its stored owner, which must be the signer.

instructions.name: create_strike_market
docs: Automation authority creates one strike market (FR-02). Stub until M1-04.

accounts.name: automation_authority
docs: The automation authority (D-030); pays for the new accounts.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The test-USDC mint pinned in the config.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the config; the payer becomes the admin (FR-01).

accounts.name: admin
docs: The deployer; becomes the admin.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: Test-USDC mint; must have 6 decimals (domain.md § Units).

instructions.name: local_oracle_set
docs: Test-only oracle writer; never in devnet builds (D-028, AB-22).

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin writes the local oracle (test only).

instructions.name: mint_pair
docs: Deposits `qty` USDC and mints `qty` YES + `qty` NO (FR-04). Stub until M1-04.

accounts.name: user
docs: The user depositing USDC.

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: The user's USDC account; the token program checks `user` may debit it.

accounts.name: user_yes
docs: Receives the YES tokens.

accounts.name: user_no
docs: Receives the NO tokens.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Global pause (FR-11). Stub until M1-04.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin.

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Places a YES bid or ask, limit or IOC (FR-05). Stub until M1-05.

accounts.name: user
docs: The order owner; pays rent for `open_orders` on first use.

accounts.name: open_orders
docs: The owner's balances in this market, created on first use.

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: USDC source (bids) and destination (ask proceeds).

accounts.name: user_yes
docs: YES source (asks) and destination (bid fills).

instructions.name: post_redstone_price
docs: Permissionless RedStone package verification and price posting (M2-15, D-054).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for the RedstonePrice account if it doesn't exist yet.

accounts.name: oracle_config
docs: OracleConfig PDA (read-only, for signer set and threshold).

accounts.name: redstone_price
docs: RedstonePrice PDA for this ticker (created if it doesn't exist, updated if it does).

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Pair redeem before settlement, winner redeem after (FR-10).

accounts.name: user
docs: The user redeeming.

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: Receives the USDC.

accounts.name: user_yes
docs: The user's YES account; the token program checks `user` may burn from it.

accounts.name: user_no
docs: The user's NO account; the token program checks `user` may burn from it.

instructions.name: sell_no
docs: IOC buy YES with a price cap + pair redeem (FR-07). Stub until M1-06.

accounts.name: user
docs: The user selling NO; pays rent for `open_orders` on first use.

instructions.name: set_oracle_config
docs: Admin sets RedStone signer set and thresholds (M2-15, D-054).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Admin signer (checked against Config.admin, payer for OracleConfig).

accounts.name: config
docs: Config account (read-only, for admin check).

accounts.name: oracle_config
docs: OracleConfig PDA (created if it doesn't exist, updated if it does).

instructions.name: settle_funds
docs: Withdraws the owner's free balances (FR-12, D-029). Stub until M1-05.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The open orders owner.

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: Receives the free USDC.

accounts.name: user_yes
docs: Receives the free YES.

instructions.name: settle_market
docs: Permissionless settlement from the two oracle feeds (FR-08).

accounts.name: feed_tiingo
docs: Feed for source slot 0 (Tiingo). Owner, address and feed hash are checked against the
config by the oracle adapter. Used for Switchboard path (M2-18 removes).

accounts.name: feed_twelve_data
docs: Feed for source slot 1 (Twelve Data). Checked like `feed_tiingo`. Switchboard path.

accounts.name: redstone_price
docs: RedStone verified price for this ticker (M2-15, D-054). Optional: if present, use
RedStone path instead of Switchboard.
AB-04: PDA seeds constraint ensures this is the price account for market.ticker.

accounts.name: oracle_config
docs: Oracle configuration with RedStone signer set. Required when using RedStone path.
AB-04: PDA seeds constraint ensures this is the canonical oracle config.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: settlement is permissionless (D-030).

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Lifts the global pause (FR-11). Stub until M1-04.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin replaces every configurable field except the admin itself (FR-01, AB-06).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: Test-USDC mint; must have 6 decimals (domain.md § Units).

instructions.name: version
docs: Logs the crate version. Kept until M1-10: the e2e placeholder calls it.

errors.name: NotImplemented
errors.msg: Instruction not implemented yet

errors.name: AdminOnly
errors.msg: Signer is not the admin

errors.name: AutomationOnly
errors.msg: Signer is not the automation authority

errors.name: InvalidUsdcMint
errors.msg: USDC mint must have 6 decimals

errors.name: InvalidTickerSymbol
errors.msg: Ticker symbol must be non-empty upper-case ASCII, zero-padded

errors.name: DuplicateTickerSymbol
errors.msg: Ticker symbols must be unique

errors.name: InvalidTickerSlot
errors.msg: Ticker slot index must be below 7

errors.name: DuplicateTickerSlot
errors.msg: A ticker slot is listed twice in one call

errors.name: TooManyTickerSlots
errors.msg: At most 6 ticker slots fit in one call

errors.name: InvalidMaxStaleness
errors.msg: max_staleness_slots must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidMaxConfBps
errors.msg: max_conf_bps must be between 1 and 10,000

errors.name: UnknownTicker
errors.msg: Ticker is not in the config

errors.name: InvalidStrike
errors.msg: Strike must be a positive multiple of $10

errors.name: InvalidTradingDate
errors.msg: Trading date must be a calendar date as YYYYMMDD

errors.name: CloseInThePast
errors.msg: Close time must be in the future

errors.name: MarketClosed
errors.msg: Market is closed: no minting or new orders at or after close_ts

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Trading is paused: no minting or new orders

errors.name: AlreadySettled
errors.msg: Market is already settled; the outcome never changes

errors.name: NotSettled
errors.msg: Market is not settled yet

errors.name: NotClosed
errors.msg: Market has not closed yet

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be between 1 and 99 cents

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity must be at least 1 contract

errors.name: TooManyRestingOrders
errors.msg: Owner already has the maximum number of resting orders in this market

errors.name: BookFull
errors.msg: Book is full and the order does not beat the worst resting order

errors.name: OrderNotFound
errors.msg: Order not found

errors.name: NotOrderOwner
errors.msg: Signer does not own this order or balance

errors.name: InsufficientOpenOrdersBalance
errors.msg: Open orders balance is insufficient

errors.name: OracleWrongOwner
errors.msg: Oracle feed account is not owned by the Switchboard program

errors.name: OracleFeedHashMismatch
errors.msg: Oracle feed hash does not match the one pinned in the config

errors.name: OracleStale
errors.msg: Oracle value is older than max_staleness_slots

errors.name: OracleBeforeClose
errors.msg: Oracle value was produced before close_ts

errors.name: OracleSpreadTooWide
errors.msg: Oracle values differ by more than max_conf_bps

errors.name: OracleInvalidValue
errors.msg: Oracle value is not a valid price

errors.name: OverrideTooEarly
errors.msg: Override is not allowed before close_ts + override_delay_secs

errors.name: RedStoneMalformedPayload
errors.msg: RedStone payload is malformed or oversized

errors.name: RedStoneInvalidSignature
errors.msg: RedStone signature verification failed

errors.name: RedStoneInsufficientSigners
errors.msg: RedStone signer threshold not met

errors.name: RedStonePackageTooLate
errors.msg: RedStone package timestamp is after close_ts + max_package_delay_secs

errors.name: RedStonePackageOlderThanStored
errors.msg: RedStone package timestamp is older than the stored value

errors.name: RedStoneWrongPricePda
errors.msg: RedStone price account is not the expected PDA for this ticker

errors.name: RedStoneFeedIdMismatch
errors.msg: RedStone feed_id does not match the canonical feed_id for this ticker

errors.name: OracleThresholdTooLow
errors.msg: Signer threshold must be at least 1

errors.name: OracleThresholdTooHigh
errors.msg: Signer threshold cannot exceed the signer count

errors.name: PairQuantityMismatch
errors.msg: Pair redeem needs equal YES and NO quantities before settlement

errors.name: NothingToRedeem
errors.msg: Nothing to redeem

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

types.name: Book
docs: The order book of one market. PDA seeds: `["book", market]`.

fields.name: bids
docs: Resting bids; empty slots have `qty == 0`.

fields.name: asks
docs: Resting asks; empty slots have `qty == 0`.

fields.name: next_seq
docs: Next order id / sequence number.

fields.name: market
docs: The market this book belongs to.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: _padding
docs: Keeps the struct free of implicit padding (bytemuck `Pod`).

types.name: BookOrder
docs: One resting order. An empty slot has `qty == 0`. Byte-for-byte the layout of
[`meridian_book::Order`] (asserted below), so M1-05 can overlay the engine's book on the
account data without copying.

fields.name: order_id
docs: Unique per market, assigned from `Book::next_seq`.

fields.name: owner
docs: Order owner.

fields.name: price
docs: Limit price, cents, 1–99.

fields.name: _padding
docs: Keeps the struct free of implicit padding (bytemuck `Pod`); mirrors `Order::_pad`.

fields.name: qty
docs: Remaining contracts.

fields.name: seq
docs: Time priority: lower fills first at the same price.

types.name: Config
docs: Global program configuration. PDA seeds: `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin: config updates, pause, add strike, settlement override (D-026, D-030).

fields.name: automation_authority
docs: Creates the daily strike markets; can do nothing else (AB-19).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Test-USDC mint (6 decimals) used as collateral everywhere.

fields.name: paused
docs: Global pause: blocks minting, new orders, `buy_no` and `sell_no` only.

fields.name: max_staleness_slots
docs: Oracle values older than this many slots are rejected at settlement.

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: Maximum spread between the two oracle values, in basis points of their mean.

fields.name: override_delay_secs
docs: Seconds after `close_ts` before `admin_settle_override` is allowed.

fields.name: tickers
docs: The MAG7 tickers with their feeds; unset slots have an all-zero symbol.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Every configurable field (everything except `admin` and `paused`), as taken by
`initialize_config` and `update_config`. `usdc_mint` is passed as an account so its decimals
can be checked. Ticker slots not listed keep their value (empty after `initialize_config`);
a full set of seven therefore takes `initialize_config` plus one `update_config`.

types.name: LocalFeed
docs: Feed written by `local_oracle_set` (D-028). PDA seeds: `["local_feed", symbol, [source_slot]]`.
Exists only in builds with the `local-oracle` feature (AB-22).

fields.name: value
docs: Price with 18 fractional digits.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Unix time of the write, from the clock.

types.name: Market
docs: One strike market. PDA seeds: `["market", symbol, trading_date_le, strike_cents_le]`.

fields.name: ticker
docs: Ticker symbol, zero-padded, as in [`super::Ticker::symbol`].

fields.name: strike_cents
docs: Strike in cents ($680 → 68,000); a multiple of [`STRIKE_STEP_CENTS`].

fields.name: trading_date
docs: ET calendar date as `YYYYMMDD`.

fields.name: close_ts
docs: Close time, unix seconds (16:00 ET, or 13:00 ET on early-close days).

fields.name: yes_mint
docs: YES mint (0 decimals, authority = this market).

fields.name: no_mint
docs: NO mint (0 decimals, authority = this market).

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC vault holding pair collateral only: balance = 1,000,000 × `pairs_outstanding`.

fields.name: escrow_usdc
docs: USDC escrow of resting bids.

fields.name: escrow_yes
docs: YES escrow of resting asks and unsettled maker credits.

fields.name: book
docs: Zero-copy order book account.

fields.name: pairs_outstanding
docs: Pairs minted and not yet redeemed.

fields.name: status
docs: `Open` or `Settled`.

fields.name: outcome
docs: `None` until settled.

fields.name: settle_price_scaled
docs: Settle price with 18 fractional digits (oracle scale); 0 until settled.

fields.name: settle_slot
docs: Oracle slot of the settle price (0 for overrides).

fields.name: settled_at
docs: Unix timestamp of settlement; 0 until settled.

fields.name: settle_source
docs: `Oracle` or `Override` once settled.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump; the market signs for its mints and token accounts.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Lifecycle state stored on-chain. "Closed" is derived: `now ≥ close_ts` and not settled.

types.name: OpenOrders
docs: Free balances of one owner in one market. PDA seeds: `["oo", market, owner]`.

fields.name: owner
docs: The owner who can withdraw these balances.

fields.name: market
docs: The market these balances belong to.

fields.name: free_usdc
docs: USDC base units withdrawable with `settle_funds`.

fields.name: free_yes
docs: YES contracts withdrawable with `settle_funds`.

fields.name: resting_count
docs: Orders currently resting on the book for this owner (cap: 8).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: OracleConfig
docs: Oracle configuration PDA `["oracle_config"]`: pinned RedStone signer set and thresholds.
Separate from `Config` so the live Config account layout is unchanged.

fields.name: signers
docs: Pinned RedStone signer set: Ethereum addresses (20 bytes each), up to 8.
A signer not in this set is ignored; an unknown signer does not cause rejection.

fields.name: signer_threshold
docs: Minimum number of valid signers required for a RedStone package to be accepted (≥ 1, ≤ signers.len()).

fields.name: max_package_delay_secs
docs: Maximum age in seconds for a RedStone package timestamp (default 600 s = 10 min).
A package timestamp after `close_ts + max_package_delay_secs` is rejected.

types.name: OrderKind
docs: How an order behaves when it does not fill completely.

types.name: Outcome
docs: Binary outcome, written once at settlement and never changed (invariant 4).

types.name: RedstonePrice
docs: RedStone verified price PDA `["redstone_price", symbol]`: stores the most recent verified
RedStone package for a ticker after `post_redstone_price` verifies signatures and threshold.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Ticker symbol (8 bytes, zero-padded).

fields.name: value
docs: Price value with 8 decimals (RedStone format).

fields.name: package_timestamp_ms
docs: Package timestamp in milliseconds (RedStone format).

fields.name: posted_slot
docs: Slot when this price was posted.

fields.name: signer_count
docs: Number of valid signers in the verified package.

fields.name: signers
docs: Pinned RedStone signer set: Ethereum addresses (20 bytes each), up to 8.

fields.name: signer_threshold
docs: Minimum number of valid signers required (≥ 1, ≤ signers.len()).

fields.name: max_package_delay_secs
docs: Maximum age in seconds for a RedStone package timestamp (default 600 s).

types.name: SettleSource
docs: Who settled the market.

types.name: Side
docs: Side of the single YES-vs-USDC book.

types.name: Ticker
docs: A ticker and its two oracle feeds (one per data source), pinned by feed hash.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Upper-case ASCII symbol, zero-padded (e.g. `b"META\0\0\0\0"`).

fields.name: feeds
docs: Switchboard feed accounts, index 0 = Tiingo, index 1 = Twelve Data.

fields.name: feed_hashes
docs: Feed hashes pinned for the accounts above, same order.

types.name: TickerSlot
docs: One ticker slot to write: `index` is the position in [`Config::tickers`].
